```python
def split_gpxs(xml: AnyStr) ->Iterable[str]:
    dom = mod_minidom.parseString(xml)
    gpx_node = _find_gpx_node(dom)
    
    if not gpx_node:
        return
    
    for child_node in list(gpx_node.childNodes):
        if child_node.nodeName in ('wpt', 'rte', 'trk'):
            new_dom = mod_minidom.parseString(xml)
            new_gpx_node = _find_gpx_node(new_dom)
            
            if new_gpx_node:
                for node_to_remove in list(new_gpx_node.childNodes):
                    if node_to_remove.nodeName in ('wpt', 'rte', 'trk'):
                        new_gpx_node.removeChild(node_to_remove)
                
                imported_node = new_dom.importNode(child_node, True)
                new_gpx_node.appendChild(imported_node)
                yield new_dom.toxml()
```

```python
def _find_gpx_node(dom: Any) ->Any:
    for node in dom.childNodes:
        if node.nodeName == 'gpx':
            return node
    return None
```
